vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: dr-context-pipeline
Version: 1.0.2

The dr-context-pipeline bundle is a legitimate architectural tool designed to standardize agent memory retrieval and compression. It uses structured YAML routing (references/router.yml) and JSON schemas to manage context, and includes an 'apply' flow to surgically patch AGENTS.md for persistence within the workspace. No indicators of data exfiltration, unauthorized network access, or malicious execution were found; the skill's behavior is transparent and aligned with its stated goal of improving retrieval correctness.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, file-based pipeline for retrieving/compressing agent memory; its requirements and instructions are coherent and proportionate to that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the actual runtime instructions: the skill standardizes routing, retrieval, compression, and linting of file-based memory. It does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or external services.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions require reading and processing workspace files (memory/always_on.md, memory/topics/*, AGENTS.md) and producing JSON bundles per supplied schemas. These file reads and edits are appropriate for a memory pipeline. The only notable scope action is surgical patching of AGENTS.md to make the pipeline the default — this is within the skill's stated goal but will change workspace behavior if applied, so review diffs when used.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This has minimal install risk (no downloads, no archives, no package installs).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Runtime instructions reference only local workspace files described in the README; there are no requests for unrelated secrets or external tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal model invocation are used (no elevated platform privileges). However, the 'apply' flow will edit AGENTS.md to make this pipeline the default behavior for the workspace — that is persistent configuration change. This is expected but should be reviewed before applying.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and focused on local, file-based memory management. Before applying it as the workspace default: (1) back up AGENTS.md and any memory files; (2) run the skill in a safe/test branch or with non-sensitive data to verify behavior; (3) review the exact AGENTS.md patch diff the agent proposes before accepting it; (4) ensure your workspace actually has the required memory layout (memory/always_on.md, memory/topics/*) or the pipeline will fail; (5) verify that the pipeline's strict rule (sources must be snippet IDs only) aligns with your auditing needs — it intentionally avoids file paths in the Context Pack, which limits direct file-path leakage. If you want additional assurance, run the provided golden tests and inspect produced Retrieval Bundle / Context Pack JSON outputs on sample inputs.
